title: Composed supervisory control: Mutually exclusive heating and cooling with deadband -> Ventilated heater startup with proof timeout

outputs.name: B_State
outputs.description: Subsystem B: 0 idle, 1 proving ventilation, 2 heating

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Subsystem B: Proof inputs are sampled at scan start.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Heat shall turn on below A_Setpoint minus 1.0 while enabled and safe.
requirements.property: G((A_Enable AND !A_SafetyTrip AND A_Temperature < A_Setpoint-1.0) -> A_Heat)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Cool shall turn on above A_Setpoint plus 1.0 while enabled and safe.
requirements.property: G((A_Enable AND !A_SafetyTrip AND A_Temperature > A_Setpoint+1.0) -> A_Cool)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Neither output shall be active inside the inclusive deadband.
requirements.property: G((A_Temperature >= A_Setpoint-1.0 AND A_Temperature <= A_Setpoint+1.0) -> (!A_Heat AND !A_Cool))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Heat and A_Cool shall never be active together, and A_SafetyTrip shall turn both off.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A healthy B_HeatRequest shall enter ventilation proving and command the damper and fan before the heater.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=0 AND B_HeatRequest AND B_GuardClosed AND !B_Stop AND !B_Fault)->X(B_State=1)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_HeaterCommand may energize only after B_DamperOpen and B_AirflowOK remain TRUE for 300 ms.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_HeaterCommand -> continuous(B_DamperOpen AND B_AirflowOK,3)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Failure to establish both proofs within 600 ms shall latch B_Fault and force all commands FALSE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (proof_timeout -> (B_Fault AND !B_DamperCommand AND !B_FanCommand AND !B_HeaterCommand)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Loss of B_GuardClosed, B_DamperOpen, or B_AirflowOK while heating shall immediately trip and latch B_Fault.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=2 AND (!B_GuardClosed OR !B_DamperOpen OR !B_AirflowOK)) -> B_Fault))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Stop shall return to idle without clearing B_Fault; B_Reset clears B_Fault only while idle with B_HeatRequest FALSE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Stop -> B_State=0)) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Reset AND B_State=0 AND !B_HeatRequest)->!B_Fault))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_HeaterCommand shall never be TRUE unless B_DamperCommand and B_FanCommand are both TRUE.
A TRUE A_Heat shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_DamperCommand AND NOT B_FanCommand AND NOT B_HeaterCommand AND NOT B_Fault AND B_State=0)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_DamperCommand AND NOT B_FanCommand AND NOT B_HeaterCommand AND NOT B_Fault AND B_State=0))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
